_authority: AUTHORED. The case grammar this parser CLAIMS, form by form. A form absent from this contract is not supported, and any form that is neither parsed nor explicitly failed closed is a defect of the kind ADV-I28AT-01 was.
_purpose: Close ADV-I28AT-01. `esac` never cleared the case-pattern skip, so every word after a `;;`-terminated case was skipped and the partial result returned as COMPLETE.
_rule: No form may silently return a partial COMPLETE result. Every form is SUPPORTED_AND_PARSED, UNSUPPORTED_AND_FAIL_CLOSED or MALFORMED_AND_FAIL_CLOSED.

branch bodies with multiple commands.why: the body is an ordinary command list

branch terminator ;&.why: the fallthrough terminator is not tokenised as a unit; it splits into `;` and `&` and the following pattern word reads as a command. It does not appear in this repository. Because the error direction is a SPURIOUS command word rather than a missing one, it fails closed: the extra word must be classified or the inventory refuses.

branch terminator ;;&.why: same as `;&`; absent from this repository and fail-closed in the same direction

case WORD in ... esac.why: the ordinary form; commands before, inside and after are all discovered

case inside command substitution.why: substitutions are scanned by a fresh nested scan

case inside conditional.why: conditional bodies are ordinary command lists

case inside function.why: function bodies are ordinary command lists

case inside loop.why: loop bodies are ordinary command lists

case inside subshell.why: the paren stack restores the enclosing position

empty case.why: no branches; esac closes the construct and scanning continues

heredocs inside branch bodies.why: heredoc bodies are inert; the opener line is a command position

malformed case.why: open-frame balance counting yields status MALFORMED

missing esac.why: open `case` frame at end of input -> MALFORMED

missing in.why: without `in` the pattern region never opens; the construct is unbalanced and fails closed

missing terminator.why: the last branch has no `;;`; if `esac` is also absent the case frame stays open

multiline patterns.why: newlines inside the pattern region are skipped with it

multiple branches.why: each `;;` re-arms the pattern skip and each `)` disarms it

nested case.why: each esac disarms the skip; balance counting detects an unclosed inner case

pattern alternation.why: `a|b)` — the `|` falls inside the pattern skip

quoted patterns.why: quoting is handled by the tokeniser

redirections.why: redirection operators are recognised and their targets consumed

wildcard branch.why: `*)` is a pattern like any other
